Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, Joannes Dominicus Mansi; tomus vicesimus quartus, ab anno MCCLXIX usque ad annum MCCXCIX (facsimile reprint of the Venice printing)
Creator: J. D. Mansi and others (eds.); facsimile reprint by H. Welter (title page)
Publisher: Venetiis: apud Antonium Zatta; reproduction en fac-similé pour H. Welter, Paris et Leipzig (title page)
Publication Date: 1903 (the facsimile's own leaf and imprint line; the OCR prints the year as '1g03' (about line 66) and 'MDCCCCIID' (line 139))
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1903); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0024joan, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (3,583,601) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1903, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair; long s is read as f. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Councils of 1269-1299. The Second Council of Lyon (1274) from about OCR line 3718 ('CONCILIUM LUGDUNENSE II ... HISTORIA EJUSDEM CONCILII') to about 12500, where the council of Salzburg begins (12516). 'Finis Tomi Vicesimiquarti' at about 119906.
